description: Return the build files for a NEW Exeris application and write none: for 'backend', a pom.xml whose parent is exeris-app-parent and which depends on exeris-app-starter; for 'frontend', a package.json with @exeris/codegen-ts and its exeris-gen generate script; for 'both', the two under backend/ and frontend/. Ask this BEFORE hand-writing a pom.xml or package.json for an Exeris application: the starter already wires the annotation processor, the codegen goals and the dependency set. Every version comes from the exeris-app-bom the bridge was released with, which names one tested tooling + kernel + SDK triple; the tool reports it as bomVersion and triple. `supplied` lists what the application still adds itself, starting with the JDBC driver. Needs no project: it reads bundled data only, and you write the files with your own tools.

variant.description: Which application to start: 'backend' (Maven), 'frontend' (npm), or 'both' (a backend and a frontend that generates from the backend's build).

name: build-get_starter
